target.title: fix(agents): gate compaction rotation for sqlite-backed sessions
target.body:
Closes #104769

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where agents using sqlite-backed session storage could hit an
`ENOENT: no such file or directory, mkdir 'sqlite:...'` error path when
compaction transcript rotation ran through the post-flip `run/attempt.ts` call
site. Rotation tries to compute a successor transcript path with
`path.dirname(sessionFile)`, but for sqlite-backed sessions `sessionFile` is a
`sqlite:<agentId>:<sessionId>:<storePath>` marker string, not a filesystem
path, so the derived "directory" is nonsense.

## Why This Change Was Made

`compact.ts` already guards its own rotation call with
`!isSqliteSessionTranscript`, but `run/attempt.ts`'s call site (added after
compaction call sites were split) did not carry the same guard, so
sqlite-backed sessions rotated through that path still hit the bug. Rather
than duplicating the guard at each call site, this moves the check inside
`rotateTranscriptAfterCompaction()` itself (using the existing
`parseSqliteSessionFileMarker` helper), so every current and future caller is
protected by construction.

## User Impact

Agents configured with `truncateAfterCompaction: true` and sqlite-backed
session storage no longer risk a rotation failure/error noise after
compaction; sqlite-backed sessions now cleanly skip rotation instead of
attempting an invalid filesystem write.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test asserting `rotateTranscriptAfterCompaction()`
  returns `{ rotated: false, reason: "sqlite-backed session" }` for a
  `sqlite:...` session file marker.
- Proved the regression: temporarily removed the new guard and reran the test,
  which failed with
  `ENOENT: no such file or directory, mkdir 'C:\...\sqlite:test-agent:test-session:...'`
  — matching the exact failure mode described in the issue. Restored the fix
  and confirmed the test passes again.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compaction-successor-transcript.test.ts` — 13/13 passed.
- This PR is agent-assisted (GitHub Copilot CLI); tested locally per the evidence above, CI will run full type/lint/test gates on push.
